## About SitePerHour

SitePerHour is a professional web development agency based in Chisinau, Moldova, founded by Mihail Mihail. We specialize in building high-quality, modern websites and web applications for businesses worldwide.

We offer custom web development, Shopify stores, WordPress solutions, CMS integrations, and ongoing website maintenance. Our expertise covers React, TypeScript, Node.js, and modern cloud platforms.

## Core Services

- Custom Web Development: React, TypeScript, Node.js, full-stack applications
- Shopify Development: Custom themes, e-commerce stores, payment integrations
- WordPress Development: Custom themes, plugins, WooCommerce integration
- CMS Solutions: WordPress, Drupal, Strapi, Contentful, custom CMS
- Website Maintenance: Security monitoring, updates, backups, performance optimization

## Pricing

- Basic Package: $497 — 5-page responsive website, 7-10 days delivery
- Medium Package: $997 — 10 pages, CMS, basic e-commerce, 10-14 days
- Premium Package: $1,997 — unlimited pages, advanced e-commerce, custom development, 14-21 days
- Custom Quote: tailored pricing for unique requirements
